caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored, likely black, suit consisting of a jacket and matching knee-length trousers. The jacket has long sleeves and features intricate, symmetrical silver or gray embroidery in horizontal bands across the front, with additional decorative embroidery on the cuffs and the front hemline, which forms an angular cut above the knees. The trousers have matching horizontal bands of the same embroidery on the upper and lower parts. The background of the image is plain and beige, and no other objects or people are present. The drawing style appears precise and detailed, and the suit is rendered flatly, without a visible hanger or internal form. The artist's signature, "Nancy Crimi," is visible in handwriting at the lower left corner of the image.
title: Boy's Suit
